source_documents.title: Rational design of a red-emissive fluorophore with AIE and ESIPT characteristics and its application in light-up sensing of esterase

reference_evidence_units.quote: compound 1 emits bright red fluorescence (λem = 650 nm, ΦF = 24.3%) in the solid state with a large Stokes shift of 174 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Bright red solid emission, 174 nm Stokes shift.

reference_evidence_units.quote: while the hydroxyl groups are responsible for ESIPT and essential for their AIE characteristics in aggregate and solid states.
reference_evidence_units.subject: salicyladazine AIEgens
reference_evidence_units.statement: ESIPT from the hydroxyl group, carried over from the authors' earlier work.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: From previous work; no enol/keto analysis for 1 in this paper.

reference_evidence_units.quote: resulting in 1 with ESIPT and strong fluorescence in the aggregate states.
The difference in the crystal structures of 1, 2 and 3 reveals that the interplanar spacing among molecules plays a decisive role in realizing the AIE characteristics of 1.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1 vs 2, 3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Interplanar spacing decides AIE vs ACQ.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The distance between the central benzene planes of adjacent molecules is 4.01 Å, which is greater than 3.80 Å and could impede intermolecular π-π interactions
reference_evidence_units.statement: J-aggregates with 4.01 Å spacing avoid π-π quenching.

reference_evidence_units.quote: confirming that ICT has little contribution to the red-shifted emission of 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Little solvatochromism: ICT excluded as origin of the red shift.

reference_evidence_units.quote: is resulted from the non-radiative decay of excited electrons due to frequent intermolecular collision
reference_evidence_units.statement: Short solution lifetime (0.2 ns) from intermolecular collisions.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: ESIPT is a design element and title claim. Weak: rests on the hydroxyl group, the large Stokes shift and the authors' earlier work; no enol/keto data here.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: AIE vs ACQ is decided by intermolecular interplanar spacing: J-aggregates of 1 at 4.01 Å avoid π-π quenching, closer packing of 2 and 3 quenches.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The short solution lifetime is ascribed to intermolecular collisions (E07), not to a restricted intramolecular motion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Little solvatochromism; the paper concludes ICT contributes little to the red emission.
